mentions.name: Sawdust
mentions.description: A skeuomorphic carpentry simulator with an agent MCP that works from real wood specs and a shop of tools like miter saws, router tables, and table saws instead of CAD-style extruded rectangles. Agents create parametric YAML procedures with full agent-human parity across every surface, including a human UI for the procedures, and can file feature requests when they reach for a tool that doesn't exist. Exports include 3D printing files, video walkthroughs, STEP files, a BOM, and a cut plan; projects can be viewed life-size in AR, and a Notion-like interface is included for authoring build guides. Users add the MCP to their agent of choice and can send a picture, description, or sketch and say "build this with Sawdust".
mentions.problem: CAD tools like SketchUp force users to work with abstract primitives such as extruding rectangles instead of real wood dimensions and shop operations.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got laid off at the end of April and have been building my own personal dream tool since, it's a skeuomorphic carpentry simulator with an agent MCP. You start with real wood specs and a shop full of miter saws, router tables, table saws and the like. Think of it like Sketchup but no extruding rectangles.
mentions.author: taylorfinley
